entities.name: Eugène Casalis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Eugène Casalis, born November 21, 1812 in Orthez and died March 9, 1891 in Paris, was a French Protestant missionary, ethnographer of Lesotho, and specialist in the Szechuan language. He founded the Protestant missions in Basutoland for twenty-two years and directed the Paris Mission House for the next twenty-five years.
